rules: primary extraction remains mandatory and unchanged
one additional independent PDF text, same raw SHA and page count
reject Unicode noncharacters, NUL, surrogates in evidence
same ordered non-whitespace evidence must occur contiguously in primary text
source excerpts and offsets refer to independently stored full view
one shared five-second extraction budget and existing byte/page/memory caps

reserved_first_use_plan.selection: Use literal contiguous primary-source token spans at these fixed fractions, clamp to source length. Nine artificial quote targets. No manual choice or adaptation.
reserved_first_use_plan.controls: Two authored English independent texts about document formatting, fixed before inspecting reserved prose.
reserved_first_use_plan.retuning_after_reveal: If policy changes after first use, mark this publication used for tuning; never call it fresh holdout again.
independent_controls: The librarian checked the spacing around headings and adjusted the page margins before sharing a short guide with colleagues. Each section explains an ordinary editorial task using independently written examples from a fictional office.

A researcher compared several document layouts and kept a notebook of questions about punctuation, numbered lists, and readable type. The exercise describes a personal workflow for reviewing drafts and makes no claim to reproduce an external publication.
